about_the_game:
Soundtrack for the 3D Side-Scrolling Shooter "Louloudi Asteri"

This is the original soundtrack for Louloudi Asteri, a 3D side-view shooting game.

Feel the excitement of the journey all over again through music!

Experience the complete soundtrack with all 20 tracks!

From the opening title to every stage and boss battle—plus the unforgettable ending theme!

Each level comes in two distinct versions: Louloudi and Asteri!
